proposition: There are hands that will hold it if you ask.
quote: "You do what is required of you," the lady said finally. "But you do not have to carry it as though there were only one shoulder convenient for it. There are hands that will hold it if you ask."

proposition: She offered to move on so as not to intrude on the sovereign's private moment.
quote: "Shall I move on, Ma'am?" she asked, scarcely louder than the scrape of the gravel.
